title: qrcode
description: `qrcode` generates a QR code from a symbol, outputting the encoded data as a list of 1s and 0s along with the QR code size as an integer. Send a symbol to set a new value and generate its code, or send a bang to generate the code for the current value; encoding quality can be selected with `@low`, `@medium`, `@quartile`, or `@high`.
